info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Prospect Campaign Management API
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Management API provides functionality for retrieving insights and details on marketing campaigns targeted at potential customers. With this API, users can access specific data related to campaigns by using unique identifiers. It's designed for marketing teams and analysts to analyze campaign effectiveness and tailor strategies accordingly. Typical use cases include fetching campaign performance metrics to inform decision-making processes and improving outreach efforts to prospects.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific prospect campaign.
get.description: Fetch the information for the prospect campaign identified by RES-100045. This endpoint allows users to access all relevant data related to the specified campaign, facilitating better decision-making and strategy formulation.

requestBody.description: Request payload for retrieving marketing prospect campaign management details for the specified campaign ID.

200.description: Operation completed successfully; returns resource details.
